Dutch positional interchange that Cruyff took to the 1974 World Cup.

How Total Football connects

  • Character: Johan Cruyff — Cruyff was the playmaker of Total Football at the 1974 World Cup.
  • Event: 1974 FIFA World Cup — Total Football had its World Cup stage in 1974.

What is Total Football?

Total Football is the Netherlands' 1970s idea that any outfield player could take any role. Cruyff's 1974 World Cup side is the tournament's textbook.

Key threads lead to Johan Cruyff and 1974 FIFA World Cup.
